title: Readiness Signal archive item
description: One published item in docs/data/archive.json (SPEC §3.2). Documentation only: validation is implemented in pipeline/lib/validate.mjs, which also applies the SPEC §6 lint (first-person voice, institution names, word limits, verbatim guard) that JSON Schema cannot express.

id.description: RS-YYMMDD-HHMM-NN: edition slot in ET, NN = 01.. within the edition ordered by section then mechanism. Unique, immutable, permalink anchor.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with the correct ET offset. Live items: the edition slot time (06:00, 10:00, 14:00, 18:00 ET).

claim.description: One line, ~12 words (hard limits 6-22, warning outside 8-16), an assertion of fact.

interpretation.description: One entry per affected domain; covers every tagged domain (tagged domains first), may add others; domains unique.

validation_question.description: Paste-ready, single line, ends with '?', <= 40 words, names no institution. Null iff mechanism is awareness_only.

candidate_issue_statement.description: Begins 'Where ' or 'If ', weakness clause, comma, consequence clause; <= 70 words; names no institution. Null iff mechanism is awareness_only.

awareness_rationale.description: Present (non-null) iff mechanism is awareness_only: why no control, metric or framework action follows; institution-neutral; <= 70 words.

sources.description: Unique URLs; first source is primary. Every URL comes from a collected candidate of the run that published the item.

backfilled.description: true only for items from the separate historical backfill pass (not built).

update_of.description: Id of an earlier item this one materially updates.

headline.description: Headline-level reference only: the source's own headline. Optional; omitted when the collector composed it (CISA KEV) or when it names a financial institution with a characterisation of its position (FILTER.md 7.8).
